## Add operator screen: Screen C claiming NEW_1
  1  GET /api/process-nodes
  2  GET /api/core-nodes

         "code": "",
         "name": "Screen C",
         "note": "spare",

         "sequence": 0,
         "controller_node_id": "",
         "enabled": true
       }

         "nodes": [
           "NEW_1"
